purpose: prospective design validation of Stage 5 condition-level secondary inference; no Stage 5 sampling
dkw_bound: two-sided DKW with Bonferroni allocation across six reference distributions
least_favorable_partial_null: assign raw p=0 to every false null; simulate the true-null p-values under zero mean

acceptance.secondary_power_gate: none was specified in the historical protocol; report with intervals, do not invent a pass gate

stream_roles: six independent null-reference calibration streams; one independent validation stream for each of ten family-by-variability cells

primary_endpoint_unchanged.endpoint: equal-weight mean of four nonzero-condition root-paired adaptive-minus-fixed LER differences
